frozen: Version 1 frozen 2026-11-14 before any run. Version 2 corrected the evening of 2026-11-14, after run 3; see 'corrections'.
about: Frozen answer key for the accuracy test: verified values for every test that comes from a PSI CSV table. Values come from data/records.json, whose evidence for each test is the raw table row; where records.json rounds a value (oxygen for ACME CFI-G and ACME Flame Design), the key uses the table's exact number. 'line' is the 1-based line number in data/raw/<file>. Only values the table itself gives are scored; a null value means the table doesn't give it, so the AI should return null. Optional fields on an expected value: 'also_ok' lists other values the same row gives for that quantity (any of them counts); 'accept' [low, high] would allow any number in a range (version 2 uses none); 'ambiguous' (with a reason) marks a value the source doesn't determine, because the row contradicts itself or the unit isn't stated. Ambiguous values are left out of the main score and reported separately; each reason was recorded as a caveat in records.json when the data was built, before any AI run.
corrections: Oxygen for ACME CFI-G and ACME Flame Design is now the table's exact initial value; version 1 rounded it to one decimal, which marked exact answers wrong by about 0.05.
ACME Flame Design pressure accepts any of the three values the table lists for a test (initial, final or mean); version 1 accepted only the mean.
ACME CFI-G burn time is the table's own number; for tests with no hot ignition the table lists 0. Version 1 expected null.

BASS-II test endings were re-read from the notes: version 1 missed 'ext' written right after a number (M17), 'out' (O6), 'no ign at any flow' (O12) and 'would not stay lit' (P8). The AI read O6, O12 and P8 correctly in run 3.
Oxygen cells that give a range (three Saffire rows, such as '21.5 - 21.7') now expect the midpoint, as the extraction instructions say; version 1 accepted any value in the range.
Values the source doesn't determine are marked 'ambiguous' and left out of the main score: BASS-II airflow (units not stated) and the contradicted values in two self-contradictory ACME CFI-G rows.

test_end_values.went_out: the flame went out on its own (e.g. 'Extinction', 'SE' = self-extinguished)
test_end_values.disruption: the droplet or fuel broke apart
test_end_values.stopped: operators ended the test, e.g. fuel flow terminated ('FT')
test_end_values.low_flow_out: the flame went out as the airflow was turned down
test_end_values.blowoff: high airflow blew the flame out
test_end_values.not_recorded: the row doesn't say how the test ended
